name: Elementary Education
summary: Elementary Education prepares students to teach children in kindergarten through about sixth grade. Students learn to teach reading, math, science, and social studies and to manage a classroom.
description: Elementary Education majors study child development, learning theory, and methods for teaching literacy, mathematics, science, social studies, and the arts to young learners. They learn classroom management, assessment, differentiated instruction for diverse learners, and how to support students with disabilities and English learners. Extensive field experience in real classrooms builds toward a full semester of student teaching. Graduates earn state teaching licensure and are in steady demand in public and private schools across the country.
